title: HTTP Method Not Restricted on Audit Endpoint
description: PUT request to audit log endpoint returned 200 instead of 405. Endpoint does not restrict method — though no data was altered the behavior is non-compliant with the immutability requirement.
risk_classification: High — violates 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail immutability requirement

title: Session Timeout Not Enforced in Test Environment
description: Session persisted beyond 15-minute idle threshold. Root cause suspected to be environment-level configuration not matching production spec.
risk_classification: Medium — security control not verified in qualification environment

title: TC-OQ-013 Blocked Pending Timeout Resolution
description: Electronic signature test blocked because prerequisite session timeout test (TC-OQ-012) has an open deviation. Cannot validate e-signature flow without stable session behavior.
risk_classification: Low — test sequence dependency only; no direct regulatory impact
